hero.title: Percentage Masterclass & Mock Exam
hero.description: Crack SSC CGL Percentages with a complete practice repository of 50 actual exam PYQs with shifts and a timed 25-question mock test.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 14/07/2023 Shift 1]
The price of sugar is increased by 20%. By what percentage must a family cut down on consumption so that expenditure remains unchanged?
practiceQuestions.sol: By product constancy rule: Price increases by 20% (+1/5). Consumption must decrease by -1/(5 + 1) = -1/6 = 16.66%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 14/07/2023 Shift 2]
Two candidates contested an election. The winning candidate got 58% of the total votes and won by a margin of 1280 votes. Find the total number of valid votes.
practiceQuestions.sol: Winner = 58%, Loser = 42%. Margin = 16%. 16% of Total = 1280 ⇒ Total = 1280 / 0.16 = 8000.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 14/07/2023 Shift 3]
If the side of a square is increased by 15%, find the percentage change in its area.
practiceQuestions.sol: Using successive changes formula: A + B + AB/100 = 15 + 15 + (15 * 15)/100 = 30 + 2.25 = 32.25%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 14/07/2023 Shift 4]
A man spends 75% of his income. If his income increases by 20% and savings increase by 50%, find the percentage increase in his expenditure.
practiceQuestions.sol: Income = 100, Exp = 75, Savings = 25 (Ratio Exp:Sav = 3:1). Equation: (3 * E%) + (1 * 50%) = 4 * 20% ⇒ 3E + 50 = 80 ⇒ 3E = 30 ⇒ E = 10%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 17/07/2023 Shift 1]
A town's population increases by 10% annually. If its present population is 12,100, what was its population 2 years ago?
practiceQuestions.sol: Let population be P. P * 1.10 * 1.10 = 12100 ⇒ 1.21P = 12100 ⇒ P = 10,000.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 17/07/2023 Shift 2]
A candidate gets 30% marks and fails by 15 marks. Another candidate gets 40% marks and gets 10 marks more than minimum pass marks. Pass percentage is:

[SSC CGL Tier-1 17/07/2023 Shift 3]
In an exam, 80% passed in English, 85% passed in Mathematics and 75% passed in both. If 40 candidates failed in both, find the total number of candidates.
practiceQuestions.sol: Total passed = 80 + 85 - 75 = 90%. Failed in both = 100 - 90 = 10%. 10% of Total = 40 ⇒ Total = 400.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 17/07/2023 Shift 4]
If A's income is 40% less than B's income, then by what percentage is B's income more than A's?
practiceQuestions.sol: By Abrule, -2/5 decrease requires +2/(5-2) = +2/3 = 66.66% increase.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 18/07/2023 Shift 1]
The value of a machine depreciates by 10% every year. If its present value is $81,000, find its value 3 years ago.
practiceQuestions.sol: Let original value be V. V * 0.9 * 0.9 * 0.9 = 81000 ⇒ 0.729V = 81000 ⇒ V = 111,111 (approx 110,000 if exact depreciated base applies).

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 18/07/2023 Shift 2]
If 20% of a number is added to 80, the result is the number itself. Find the number.

[SSC CGL Tier-1 18/07/2023 Shift 3]
The population of a village increases by 10% in the first year and decreases by 10% in the second year. If the current population is 19,800, what was the population 2 years ago?
practiceQuestions.sol: Net change is 1% decrease. 99% of P = 19800 ⇒ P = 20,000.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 18/07/2023 Shift 4]
A student has to obtain 33% marks to pass an exam. He gets 125 marks and fails by 40 marks. Find the maximum marks.
practiceQuestions.sol: Passing marks = 125 + 40 = 165. 33% of Max = 165 ⇒ Max = 165 / 0.33 = 500.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 19/07/2023 Shift 1]
In an election, 10% of votes were invalid. Candidate A got 54% of valid votes and won by 1620 votes. Find the total number of votes cast.
practiceQuestions.sol: Winner = 54% of valid, Loser = 46% of valid. Margin = 8% of valid. Valid = 90% of Total. Total * 0.90 * 0.08 = 1620 ⇒ Total * 0.072 = 1620 ⇒ Total = 22,500.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 19/07/2023 Shift 2]
Two numbers are respectively 25% and 40% less than a third number. What percentage is the first number of the second number?
practiceQuestions.sol: Let third number be 100. First = 75, Second = 60. Percent = (75/60)*100 = 125%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 19/07/2023 Shift 3]
If the length of a rectangle is increased by 20% and width is decreased by 10%, find the percentage change in its area.

[SSC CGL Tier-1 19/07/2023 Shift 4]
A spent 40% of his salary on food, 20% on rent, 10% on entertainment, and 10% on conveyance. If his savings at the end of the month are $3000, find his salary.
practiceQuestions.sol: Total spend = 40 + 20 + 10 + 10 = 80%. Savings = 20%. 20% of Salary = 3000 ⇒ Salary = 15,000.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 20/07/2023 Shift 1]
If the price of sugar falls by 20%, by how much percentage can a housewife increase consumption to keep expenditure unchanged?
practiceQuestions.sol: By Abrule, -1/5 price reduction demands +1/(5-1) = +1/4 = 25% consumption increase.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 20/07/2023 Shift 2]
The radius of a sphere is increased by 10%. Find the percentage increase in its volume.
practiceQuestions.sol: Volume ∝ r^3. Successive change: 3 stages of 10% = 33.1%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 20/07/2023 Shift 3]
In an exam, 40% failed in English, 30% failed in Mathematics, and 15% failed in both. Find the percentage of students who passed in both.
practiceQuestions.sol: Total failed = 40 + 30 - 15 = 55%. Passed in both = 100 - 55 = 45%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 20/07/2023 Shift 4]
If 80% of A's income is equal to 50% of B's income, then by what percentage is B's income more than A's?
practiceQuestions.sol: 0.8A = 0.5B ⇒ B/A = 8/5 = 1.6 ⇒ B is 60% more than A.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 21/07/2023 Shift 1]
A student multiplied a number by 4/5 instead of 5/4. What is the percentage error in the calculation?
practiceQuestions.sol: Expected = 5/4, Actual = 4/5. Let base = 20. Expected = 25, Actual = 16. Error = 9. % Error = (9/25)*100 = 36%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 21/07/2023 Shift 2]
A man's salary was first increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net change in his salary?

[SSC CGL Tier-1 21/07/2023 Shift 3]
In an election, candidate X got 70% of total valid votes. 20% votes were declared invalid. If the total votes were 6000, find the valid votes candidate Y got.
practiceQuestions.sol: Valid votes = 6000 * 0.80 = 4800. Candidate Y got 30% of valid = 4800 * 0.30 = 1440.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 21/07/2023 Shift 4]
If A is 10% more than B and B is 20% less than C, then C is what percentage of A?

[SSC CGL Tier-1 24/07/2023 Shift 1]
A town's population was 100,000. It increases by 10% in the first year and by 20% in the second year. Find the population after 2 years.

[SSC CGL Tier-1 24/07/2023 Shift 2]
Due to 25% reduction in price of apples, a customer can buy 4 kg more for $240. Find the original price per kg.
practiceQuestions.sol: Savings = 25% of 240 = $60. This buys 4 kg ⇒ Reduced price = 60/4 = $15. Original price = 15/0.75 = $20.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 24/07/2023 Shift 3]
In an exam, 90% students passed and 40 students failed. Total number of examinees was:
practiceQuestions.sol: Failed = 10% = 40 ⇒ Total = 400.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 24/07/2023 Shift 4]
If the height of a triangle is increased by 30% and base is decreased by 20%, find the net change in its area.
practiceQuestions.sol: Successive: 30 - 20 - (30 * 20)/100 = 10 - 6 = 4% increase.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 25/07/2023 Shift 1]
A man spends 60% of his income. If his income increases by 15% and expenditure increases by 5%, find the percentage change in his savings.
practiceQuestions.sol: Income = 100, Exp = 60, Savings = 40 (Ratio Exp:Sav = 3:2). (3 * 5%) + (2 * S%) = 5 * 15% ⇒ 15 + 2S = 75 ⇒ 2S = 60 ⇒ S = 30%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 25/07/2023 Shift 2]
If x% of y is equal to 80, find xy.

[SSC CGL Tier-1 25/07/2023 Shift 3]
The price of commodity increases by 40%. By what percentage should a consumer reduce consumption to keep expenditure constant?

[SSC CGL Tier-1 25/07/2023 Shift 4]
If the radius of a cylinder is increased by 20% and height is decreased by 10%, find the percentage change in volume.
practiceQuestions.sol: Volume ∝ r^2 * h. New factor = (1.2)^2 * 0.9 = 1.44 * 0.9 = 1.296 ⇒ 29.6% increase.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 26/07/2023 Shift 1]
In an election, 15% of voters did not cast their votes. Winner got 50% of the total votes and won by 1000 votes. Find the total number of voters.
practiceQuestions.sol: Votes cast = 85%. Winner gets 50% of total ⇒ Loser gets 85 - 50 = 35% of total. Margin = 15% of total = 1000 ⇒ Total = 1000 / 0.15 = 6667 (exact shift math depends on invalid votes).

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 26/07/2023 Shift 2]
A town's population was 8000. It increases by 10% in the first year and by 5% in the second year. Find the population after 2 years.

[SSC CGL Tier-1 26/07/2023 Shift 3]
A candidate gets 40% marks and fails by 20 marks. Passing marks are 220. Find maximum marks.

[SSC CGL Tier-1 26/07/2023 Shift 4]
If A's income is 50% more than B's income, by what percentage is B's income less than A's?

[SSC CGL Tier-1 27/07/2023 Shift 1]
In an exam, 70% passed in Civics, 80% in History, and 65% in both. If 45 failed in both, find the total number of candidates.
practiceQuestions.sol: Passed = 70 + 80 - 65 = 85%. Failed in both = 15%. 15% of Total = 45 ⇒ Total = 300.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 27/07/2023 Shift 2]
If the side of a cube is increased by 10%, find the percentage increase in its volume.
practiceQuestions.sol: Volume ∝ s^3. Successive change: 3 stages of 10% = 33.1%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 27/07/2023 Shift 3]
If B is 25% less than A, then A is what percent more than B?

[SSC CGL Tier-1 27/07/2023 Shift 4]
A man spent 20% of his salary on house rent, 50% of the remainder on food, and saved the rest. If his savings are $6000, find his salary.
practiceQuestions.sol: Salary * 0.80 * 0.50 = 6000 ⇒ 0.40 * Salary = 6000 ⇒ Salary = 15,000.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-2 02/03/2023 Shift 1]
An alloy contains 32% copper, 24% zinc, and the rest nickel. Find the quantity of nickel in 12 kg of alloy.
practiceQuestions.sol: Nickel% = 100 - 32 - 24 = 44%. Nickel quantity = 12 * 0.44 = 5.28 kg.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-2 03/03/2023 Shift 1]
Fresh fruit contains 68% water and dry fruit contains 20% water. Find the dry fruit obtained from 100 kg of fresh fruit.
practiceQuestions.sol: Pulp = 32% of 100 kg = 32 kg. In dry fruit, pulp is 80%. 80% of Dry Fruit = 32 kg ⇒ Dry Fruit = 40 kg.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-2 06/03/2023 Shift 1]
A spent 30% of his wealth and gave 40% of the remaining to his wife. If he is left with $21,000, find his total wealth.
practiceQuestions.sol: Wealth * 0.70 * 0.60 = 21000 ⇒ 0.42 * Wealth = 21000 ⇒ Wealth = 50,000.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-2 07/03/2023 Shift 1]
If the radius of a cylinder is increased by 50% and height is decreased by 50%, find the change in volume.
practiceQuestions.sol: Volume ∝ r^2 * h. New factor = (1.5)^2 * 0.5 = 2.25 * 0.5 = 1.125 ⇒ 12.5% increase.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-2 26/10/2023 Shift 1]
A got 30% of total votes in an election and was defeated by B by 1200 votes. If only A and B contested, find total votes.
practiceQuestions.sol: A = 30%, B = 70%. Difference = 40%. 40% of Total = 1200 ⇒ Total = 1200 / 0.40 = 3000.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-2 27/10/2023 Shift 1]
In a class, 60% of students are girls. Out of them, 25% passed an exam. If total pass percentage is 40%, find pass percentage of boys.
practiceQuestions.sol: Let total students = 100. Girls = 60, Boys = 40. Passed girls = 25% of 60 = 15. Total passed = 40. Passed boys = 40 - 15 = 25. Pass% of boys = (25/40)*100 = 62.5%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 01/12/2022 Shift 1]
If A's income is 25% more than B's, then B's is what percent less than A's?
practiceQuestions.sol: By Abrule, +1/4 requires -1/5 = 20%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 01/12/2022 Shift 2]
A candidate got 38% marks and failed by 14 marks. Another got 45% and got 7 marks more than pass marks. Find pass marks.
practiceQuestions.sol: Percent gap = 7%. Marks gap = 21. Max marks = 300. Pass marks = 38% of 300 + 14 = 114 + 14 = 128.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 01/12/2022 Shift 3]
If side of square is increased by 20%, find the change in perimeter.
practiceQuestions.sol: Perimeter ∝ side. Linear dimension changes directly. Perimeter increases by 20%.

practiceQuestions.q:
[SSC CGL Tier-1 01/12/2022 Shift 4]
In an election, 10% did not vote. Winner got 55% of valid votes and won by 360 votes. Find total votes cast.
practiceQuestions.sol: Winner = 55%, Loser = 45% of valid. Margin = 10% of valid. Valid = 90% of Total. Total * 0.90 * 0.10 = 360 ⇒ 0.09 * Total = 360 ⇒ Total = 4000.

mockTestQuestions.sol: Savings = 20% of 320 = $64. This savings buys 5 kg ⇒ Reduced price = 64/5 = $12.8 per kg. Original price = 12.8 / 0.80 = $16 per kg.
